## Description

Computes non-linear Transfer Entropy between asset price series to detect directional information flow and lead-lag relationships before price transmission completes.

## Where it may fit

E-mini S&P vs ETF baskets, crypto spot vs perpetual futures, fragmented market liquidity transmission.

## Vehicles

High-frequency trading firms, statistical arbitrage desks.

## Required data

Synchronized sub-second or millisecond trade execution timestamps and price tick streams.

## Caveats

Computationally demanding probability density estimation for continuous time series.
